M.A.S.K. for Essence20

Homebrew support for playing M.A.S.K. - the Mobile Armored Strike Kommand against V.E.N.O.M. - with the Essence20 system. Nothing here changes the system: it is compendium content, house rules and two small rule tags, all in this module.

Setting up a world

  • Set the Game Line (Configure Settings) to GI Joe, or leave it on all lines. M.A.S.K. plays on the G.I. Joe rules: agents take G.I. Joe Roles and Origins, and the Party is a Strike Team.
  • Turn on the M.A.S.K. house rules you want under Configure Settings → House Rules (see the next page).
  • The M.A.S.K. compendiums sit in their own M.A.S.K. folder; picking a game line never switches a module's books off.

Status: the compendiums are being filled in. This guide grows with them.

House rules

  • Bonded Masks (on by default): a mask's power works only for the agent it is bonded to; anyone else wearing it has only the helmet. Off: anyone can use any mask.
  • Concealed Weapons (on by default): a vehicle's Strike-only weapons cannot fire while it is in Civilian Mode - the attack is refused before its action is spent. Mark an attack Strike-only with the flag flags.essence20-homebrew-starter.strikeOnly: true.
  • Disguised Vehicles: a vehicle in Civilian Mode gets an Edge on Deception and Infiltration - it passes for ordinary traffic.

Both rules ones can be rebuilt by hand with New House Rule:

  • Disguised Vehicles: a RollModifier with an Edge, when self:type:vehicle, not:self:marked:strikeMode and either skill:deception or skill:infiltration.
  • Concealed Weapons: a BeforeRoll with Cancel and Early, when self:type:vehicle, not:self:marked:strikeMode and item:data:flags.essence20-homebrew-starter.strikeOnly=true.

Masks

A mask is a piece of gear carrying the flag flags.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask: true. Wearing it is having it equipped.

  • Its power is a Use rule, usable a number of times per scene equal to the wearer's Speed: limit {per: scene, max: @essence.speed}. Give the power's rules the condition self:maskBonded.
  • The helmet - its protection - is an ordinary Defense rule with no condition, so it works for any wearer.
  • One at a time: a Veto rule on every mask, {on: equip, items: [item:mask]} when self:wearingItem:item:mask.
  • Bonds: a mask nobody has worn bonds to the first agent who puts it on. A mask taken from someone stays theirs until the GM runs the Rebond Mask macro (after the lab work and downtime the story calls for - a Smarts (Technology) test is a good fit).

Vehicles: Civilian and Strike Mode

Each M.A.S.K. vehicle is built as it looks on the road - its Civilian Mode. Its Strike Mode feature (a vehicle upgrade) carries two Use buttons: Strike Mode! (a mark step, key strikeMode, no duration - it stays until cleared) and Civilian Mode (an unmark step). Everything that changes when it converts is a rule with the condition self:marked:strikeMode: movement, Defenses, and the weapons - each weapon system is its own upgrade with a Use button that only appears in Strike Mode. Vehicles roll their weapons with their own Skill dice.

A vehicle's linked mask power - a crew member's mask firing through it - is a Use with the condition self:crewWearing:<mask name>, once per scene. It appears only while someone aboard wears that mask (and it works for them).

Vehicles that carry another (the Rhino's ATV) keep its token hidden on the scene. Target it and press the carrier's Deploy: it appears just beside the carrier. Dock hides it again. The crew move across by dragging.

Defenses are the system's own: base 10 plus Strength (Toughness) or Speed (Evasion). A vehicle with no qualified driver moves at half speed - that is the system's rule too.

Mask roster

Every mask in the M.A.S.K. Masks compendium. Powers are this module's own design - the toys only name each mask and what it does. Each works for its bonded agent a number of times per scene equal to their Speed, and every mask gives +1 Toughness to whoever wears it. New Blaster and New Torch were planned for the toy line but never sold.

Agents: Origins and Perks

M.A.S.K. agents are built as G.I. Joe characters: a G.I. Joe Role, then an Origin - a G.I. Joe one or one of the six below - and Perks. The M.A.S.K. Origins work like the book's: drop one on a character, pick the Essence to raise and a Skill from its list, and it sets starting Health and Ground Movement and grants its Origin Perk. V.E.N.O.M. agents use the same Origins.

Mask Agent Perks

General Perks, taken like any other.

  • @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_options.Item.YYa9c4u36jtcEo0C]{Hardened Mask}: You have reinforced your helmet. While you wear a mask, you have +1 Toughness on top of the helmet's own.
  • @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_options.Item.4ctzeHcyYOCrXnmh]{Quick Change}: You can swap masks - or draw a weapon - in the blink of an eye. Once per turn, the Draw Weapon action is a free action for you. (At the table, putting on or swapping a mask is a Draw Weapon action.)
  • @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_options.Item.KsjAKJeQC1KCYIjW]{Secret Identity}: By day you have an ordinary life, and you work hard to keep it. Your Cover starts at 5. While it holds and you wear no mask, your Deception Tests have Edge. When the GM decides you slipped - seen unmasking, a vehicle followed home - you lose 1 Cover; at 0 your identity is blown. Once per mission, lying low restores 1.
  • @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_options.Item.kz9WteU24VypCcZT]{Signature Mask}: You and your mask are one. Rolls made with your mask's power are upshifted once.
  • @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_options.Item.pXYCHGF7u34E4SOE]{Vehicle Bond}: You know your ride like your own hands. A vehicle you are driving has +1 Evasion and Edge on its Driving Tests.
  • @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_options.Item.awnfquQtCuvdnm5Y]{Wheel Gunner}: You drive with one hand and aim with the other. A vehicle you are driving has Edge on its Targeting Tests.

Putting on a mask

The system doesn't charge an action for equipping gear, so this is a table rule: putting on or swapping a mask is the Draw Weapon action (a Move action). The Quick Change Perk makes it Free once per turn.
